title: #241 – Boris Sofman: Waymo, Cozmo, Self-Driving Cars, and the Future of Robotics
summary: Boris Sofman is the Senior Director Of Engineering and Head of Trucking at Waymo, formerly the Google Self-Driving Car project. He was also the CEO and co-founder of Anki, a home robotics company.
